name: siv3d
description: Siv3D (siv8) third-party dependencies managed via vcpkg manifest mode.
$comment-scope: Only libraries that exist as vcpkg ports are listed here. Header-only ports (earcut-hpp, pcg, parallel-hashmap, mapbox-variant, libmorton, rapidhash, wyhash, miniaudio, drlibs, fast-float) do NOT all export a CMake config; wrap them with INTERFACE targets in CMake where needed.
$comment-not-in-vcpkg: These ThirdParty libs are NOT on vcpkg and must stay vendored or be provided via overlay-ports/: EnumBitmask, Xoshiro-cpp, libcpprime, Obfuscate, RFC1321, Wintab, bc7enc_rdo, levenshtein-sse, miniutf, r8brain-free-src, rectpack2D, serial_cpp, tinycolormap, PDFium. (Foundation/Metal/QuartzCore are Apple system frameworks linked via find_library, not packages.)
$comment-baseline-lag: ThirdParty.md pins newer versions than this baseline carries, so no override is set for: doctest (2.5.2 vs 2.4.12), double-conversion (3.4.0 vs 3.3.1), fast-float (8.2.4 vs 8.1.0), libjpeg-turbo (3.1.4.1 vs 3.1.2), libpng (1.6.58 vs 1.6.51), nanoflann (1.9.0 vs 1.8.0), simdutf (7.7.1 vs 7.7.0), zlib (1.3.2 vs 1.3.1). Bump builtin-baseline or add a custom registry to pin these exactly.
$comment-bundled-workaround: rapidhash is deliberately NOT listed here: its vcpkg port fails to install, so the bundled header (Siv3D/src/ThirdParty/rapidhash/rapidhash.h) is used instead, reached via the <ThirdParty/...> include path in CMakeLists.txt (GROUP B). Re-add it to dependencies once the vcpkg port is fixed.
